pr_title: Fixes #12000: When viewport is set to camera and switched to SizedFul…
pr_body:
# Objective

- When viewport is set to the same size as the window on creation, when adjusting to SizedFullscreen, the window may be smaller than the viewport for a moment, which caused the arguments to be invalid and panic.
- Fixes #12000.

## Solution

- The fix consists of matching the size of the viewport to the lower size of the window ( if the x value of the window is lower, I update only the x value of the viewport, same for the y value). Also added a test to show that it does not panic anymore.

---
